**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`

@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    rejectBlankOwnerFields(ownerFieldsDto);        // (a) blank guard
    normalizeTelephone(ownerFieldsDto);            // (b) phone normalize + validate
    rejectDuplicateTelephone(ownerFieldsDto.getTelephone());  // (c) phone uniqueness
    rejectDuplicateHousehold(ownerFieldsDto);      // (d) household uniqueness
    normalizeEmail(ownerFieldsDto);                // (e) email normalize + validate
    HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);   // (f) DTO -> entity
    if (owner.getRegistrationDate() == null) {           // (g) default reg date

    }
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);                  // (h) persist
    OwnerDto ownerDto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
    headers.setLocation(UriComponentsBuilder.newInstance()
        .path("/api/owners/{id}").buildAndExpand(owner.getId()).toUri());
